scope: Two frozen-source 60-wall-second marker/IMU+marker actual seven-channel runs; independent native board/Bayes/joint-state/K-ledger/point-query/modal-TF and full-J selection checks. Numerical consistency is verified; physical reaching is not achieved and K accuracy is not established. A later audit found that its changed K posterior often did not refine the numerical representative used by IK; this historical source predates that fix.

method.central_fusion: ascending-ID image-only ADF with known attachments; broad intermediate projection deferred with every full-covariance branch retained; broad final mixture retained
method.selection: Every reaching cycle evaluates the complete Gaussian/Bingham-mixture J and one complete gradient; visual centering is only an initial-point proposal. Accepted candidates are checked against the recorded position-error expectation constraint.

board_image_only_fusion.sensitive_density_check: Independent chart/full covariance check at fixed tolerances, then recompute products/evidence from exactly disclosed Gaussian operands to avoid condition-amplified last-bit differences; no tolerance widening.

executed_interval_progress.meaning: same adopted control law pushed through the actual recorded command history to each interval endpoint; no observation update is compared

absolute_pose_accuracy.covariance_width_definition: 3*sqrt(trace(P)), a diagnostic Euclidean width; anisotropic Gaussian proxy coverage uses support-aware Mahalanobis chi-square95

historical_runs.details: Original .048m/.06m/.18m board stopped when a genuinely broad intermediate mixture exceeded the unchanged core single-pose concentration domain. The later explicit deferred projection/final-mixture fallback addresses this; the original failure is preserved.

historical_runs.details: Old expensive subscriber parsing lost 3/20 distribution messages and 22/9 snapshots. No full actual-wire pass is claimed for that run; its far visual controller is superseded.

historical_runs.classification: unexecuted draft, not a runtime failure

K_action_physical_diagnostic.interpretation: Recorded auxiliary equilibrium delta equals same-K recomputation; selected diagnostic displacement directions mostly agree with true-K physical FK. This is not a proof of globally correct K estimation or successful reaching.

limitations: The K posterior changes were often not reflected in its numerical representative: new-factor refinement was skipped in 105/110 combined and 121/123 marker selections. This source is retained as historical failure evidence; see K_representative_followup and the separate corrected-source report.

Both physical runs fail the unchanged 6mm reach condition. Passing numerical identity/full-J constraints does not establish physical success, calibrated uncertainty, or correctness of the estimated-K command effect.
The one-step horizon s constraint is distinct from a guarantee on each 20Hz interpolated physical interval: marker/combined have 3/6 reaching-interval s increases, separately measured.

Observation updates can change the relative target error at fixed command. The combined 11.72s jump is under separate direct-camera/root-collapse diagnosis; root goal movement alone does not identify the cause.
The board assumes conditional independence of tag corner likelihoods; shared image errors and ordered ADF approximation are explicit. Final broad mixtures remain; no native mode is dropped.
The existing Bingham-derived core forward moments and single-root-pose approximation need not close exactly under an inverse query; measured residuals are disclosed without cosmetic recentering.
Only selected latest captures are fused; every acquired capture and skipped index is archived. IMU is attached to link_3 in these runs.
Raw detector visibility is image evidence. Physical corner/FK/true-K evaluations are validation only and were not inference/control inputs.
Current absolute body distributions remain overconfident in the recorded trajectory. Coverage counts are descriptive, not a calibration guarantee.

K_representative_followup.defect: A previous representative winning against fixed starts suppressed score refinement even when a new density factor changed the continuous posterior.
K_representative_followup.implication: K density/score and same-K command/wire identity are distinct from numerical representative adaptation. Passing this report did not establish the latter.
